entries.04c10c0384e236af: A company whose main business is online printing mail order, in which orders and print data are received through a website, then printed and processed at its own factories and shipped to customers.
entries.08d645b4cdef0803: This business is not included in the reportable segments and operates dispensing pharmacies, among other activities. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥95 million.
entries.126fba56036d3a1e: The sole reportable segment, which receives orders and print data over the internet, prints and processes them at its own plants, and ships them to customers.
entries.4c53c3f92c6636df: Through “gang printing,” which efficiently arranges data from multiple orders on 1 printing plate, it reduces the number of plates used and lowers costs. It was among the first in the printing industry to obtain Japan Color standard printing certification to stabilize quality, and it operates 9 large offset printing presses. It also provides a shipping agency service that allows printing and design firms to ship to end customers without informing them of the company’s involvement.
entries.4f31de1f4b93482e: Companies, organizations and individuals that use printed materials
entries.5bc7147bf9ba2922: Its customers are companies and organizations that use printed matter, individuals, and printing and design firms that receive printing orders from end customers and subcontract their production; the proportion of contracted work is high.
entries.6c242bc73ac0a34b: Net income for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥433 million, an increase from the previous year.
entries.7496b4e900186b56: The printing industry as a whole has continued to see declines in production volume and shipment value due to falling demand for print media, while the online printing market is forecast to keep expanding. Online printing has seen intensified price competition due to an increase in market entrants, but in recent years new entries have been declining, and the market is said to be becoming an oligopoly in which the top few companies account for about 3/4 of market size.
entries.757fd388680ae695: Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥9,213 million, a decline from the previous year, while net income was ¥433 million, an increase from the previous year. It is stated that, as the company shifted to a policy of prioritizing profit margins over revenue, printing sales to major customers declined, while printing sales to customers other than major customers increased.
entries.7a0e56c8654c2fc9: Based on the business environment section under “Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address, etc.,” which states trends in the printing industry as a whole, expected growth of the online printing market, and forecasts of market entry trends and oligopolization.
entries.7ad6d02bc5aab52c: Based on the descriptions of the gang printing mechanism, acquisition of Japan Color standard printing certification and the shipping agency service in “Business Overview,” and on the number of large offset printing presses stated in Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition, Results of Operations and Cash Flows.

entries.b7aae24b4499f05c: Through gang printing, which combines complete data submitted by customers for multiple orders onto 1 printing plate, it reduces the number of plates, aiming to lower costs and improve the efficiency of offset printing.
entries.c146cc28db1ecd8d: On the websites for “PRINTNET,” “Purinto Puro” and “PRINTNET Wear,” it posts specifications and prices for printed items, accepts orders and print data online, and prints and processes them at its own plants.
entries.c5a32cb09a4bbcba: Founded in 1968 in Kagoshima Prefecture, it is a printing company with its head office in Kagoshima City. It has no affiliated companies and operates on a standalone basis; as of August 31, 2025, it had 256 employees.
entries.ca191870718dec37: This is the only reportable segment: it accepts orders and print data over the internet, prints and processes them at its own factories, and ships them to customers. It keeps costs down by reducing the number of plates through "gang printing", which places the complete data submitted by customers for multiple orders together on 1 plate. It produces at the Tokyo Nishi Factory (Uenohara, Yamanashi) and the Kyushu Factory (Aira, Kagoshima), and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥9,118 million.
entries.d5d998453f474a94: Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥9,213 million, of which the Online Printing Mail-Order Business accounted for ¥9,118 million and other businesses (such as pharmacy operations) for ¥95 million.
entries.dc64b4fead669150: The core site offers enhanced services, including telephone support through the company's own call center, and is used mainly for business purposes.

entries.dfe936c46584ba11: Its corporate motto is “Advance together with everyone with a humble heart.” To build a solid management foundation that can make use of all changes, its policies include: continued sales growth through proprietary marketing; construction of a next-generation core system; improved earnings through restraint of fixed costs and review of product mix; building systems to develop people; and proprietary production automation.
